title: English Practice Quiz 0978
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A good team leader should ___.
options: listen to team members and set clear expectations
questions.explanation: Listening and clear expectations support effective teamwork.

questions.question: Delegating a task means ___.
questions.explanation: Delegation assigns work and appropriate responsibility.

questions.question: Constructive feedback should focus on ___.
options: specific behaviour and ways to improve
questions.explanation: Specific feedback is more useful and fair than personal criticism.

questions.question: A team member who is 'cooperative' is willing to ___.
questions.explanation: Cooperative people work together towards shared outcomes.

questions.question: When two colleagues disagree, a manager should first ___.
questions.explanation: Hearing both sides helps establish the facts.

questions.question: A shared team objective is a goal that ___.
options: must remain secret from the team
questions.explanation: A shared objective aligns team effort.

questions.question: To 'mentor' a new employee means to ___.
questions.explanation: Mentoring helps someone develop skills and confidence.

questions.question: Which action builds trust within a team?
questions.explanation: Reliability and honesty are foundations of trust.

questions.question: A team briefing should make responsibilities ___.
options: different for each person without explanation
questions.explanation: Clear responsibilities reduce confusion and overlap.

questions.question: Recognising a colleague's contribution means ___.
options: acknowledging the work they have done
claiming their work as your own
questions.explanation: Acknowledgement shows that contributions are valued.
